table.name: device_references
columns: revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: device_reference_id is immutable opaque UUIDv4 operational identity
operational_name is descriptive evidence/current operator-facing text, never relational identity
equal names are valid and never auto-merge Device References
LLD-03 stores no Network Element, Site, Customer, Model, serial, IP, Rack, Cloud or Infrastructure ownership shortcut on Device Reference
registered/unregistered state is derived from the optional LLD-08 DeviceReference-to-NetworkElement resolution relationship rather than duplicated here
a Device Reference remains fully valid without any Infrastructure resolution
regularization cannot replace device_reference_id or any SR/RFC/Task/Inventory relationship that targets it
correction of operational_name increments revision and is audited; it never rewrites historical operation-specific snapshots stored elsewhere

matching_handoff.rule: LLD-08 may use the current operational name/hostname text as exact candidate evidence for Network Element regularization, but descriptive equality never authorizes resolution or merge; operator confirmation/deliberate promotion remains required.

prohibitions: no automatic merge on equal operational_name
